bio: Lorne Sanny, mentored by Navigator founder Dawson Trotman, was the Navigator General Director for 30 years. Loren Sanny is a man who has lived his life consistently following Christ. His life is an example to anyone who wants to finish well in life. He has extensive discipling experience and generously passes it on to others. You will learn from him how you too can become an effective disciplemaker.
